relationships.subject: salidroside
relationships.evidence_quote: SAL treatment significantly alleviated pain behaviors in BCP mice (p < 0.01).

relationships.subject: salidroside
relationships.evidence_quote: SAL activated the AMPK/SIRT1 pathway, while pathway inhibitors reversed SAL's therapeutic effects, confirming the mechanism.

relationships.subject: salidroside
relationships.evidence_quote: Cellular analyses revealed SAL restored Th17/Treg balance by reducing Th17 markers (IL-17, RORγt, p-STAT3) and increasing Treg markers (FOXP3, p-STAT5).

key_findings: Salidroside alleviates bone cancer pain in mice by restoring spinal Th17/Treg balance.
The effect depends on AMPK/SIRT1 pathway activation, as inhibitors reversed it.
